title: Layout / Overview

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; visible default tab states

slide_intent: Coordinate elements into a purposeful whole so a viewer can find meaning through hierarchy, space and relationships.
strategic_value: Essential content, dynamic balance and engineered alignment can make IBM communication recognizable across editorial, event and product contexts.
demonstration: The page introduces three layout qualities—Essential, Dynamic and Engineered—and pairs each with named examples including field guides, a business card, interfaces, posters and philosophy cards.
practical_value: Evaluate a composition against the three qualities while recognizing that one design need not express all three equally.

content_islands.name: Point of view
content_islands.spec: Begin with the title and rationale explaining how arrangement expresses IBM character.

content_islands.name: Essential
content_islands.spec: Pair the criteria with field-guide covers, a business card and a Security Connect interface, keeping short captions beside each example.

content_islands.name: Dynamic
content_islands.spec: Follow with an ethics publication, Project Debater page and blueprint poster demonstrating variation, contrast and spatial movement.

content_islands.name: Engineered
content_islands.spec: Close with philosophy cards, a Town Hall poster and Garage posters whose repeated alignment and grid structures make their logic visible.

reference_purposes.Intent: The point-of-view section says arrangement is essential to achieving IBM’s look; each quality connects a design approach to communication or brand character.
reference_purposes.Expression: The page shows recurring IBM blue, Plex typography, geometric imagery and asymmetric compositions across different media.
reference_purposes.Application: Named examples demonstrate how negative space, hierarchy, repetition and alignment enact the three qualities.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source qualifies these qualities at the aggregate level: individual designs do not need to feature all of them equally.

inspection.method: Six uniformly spaced sampled frames across the complete clip
